business_problem: move beyond on-premises data silos and slow infrastructure upgrades so teams could share trusted data products, scale instantly, and shorten time to insight.
solution_summary: Flix uses Snowflake and Internal Marketplace on Snowflake to move beyond on-premises data silos and slow infrastructure upgrades so teams could share trusted data products, scale instantly, and shorten time to insight. Marketing, journey, and customer feedback data that were previously split across siloed systems now land in a shared Snowflake environment. Flix organizes those datasets as reusable data products in a data mesh, with Internal Marketplace listings exposing governed assets to teams that need them. Business units can combine data across pre-travel, travel, and post-travel stages to analyze operations, improve the offering, and scale analytics without waiting on a central data team. Keeping ingestion, storage, transformation, and downstream access on one governed platform reduces data copying, simplifies operations, and gives teams a single trusted operating view for analytics and AI.
